answer_1.quote: Answers produced by generative models for questions from the ERVQA dataset are open ended
answer_1.outputs: open-ended answers to visual questions in healthcare settings

answer_2.quote: To evaluate generated answers against ground truth, we use traditional model-free metrics such as BLEU-1, which compares unigrams, and ROUGE-L, which compares longest common subsequences. For semantic similarity, we use SentenceBERT Similarity. ... we adapt two model based evaluation metrics ... Entailment Score ... CLIPScore Confidence

answer_4.quote: The error annotation for each question was done by our expert annotators
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given definitions of the 8 error types and asked to identify all possible errors applicable to the answer
